ledger: Man (real body and mirror reflection) | dark slicked-back hair, white collared button-up shirt, holding light-colored razor, standing facing bathroom mirror (real body back/side to camera, reflection front-facing to camera) | same hair, same white shirt, same razor, same position facing mirror | motion sequence chin->forehead->cheek repeats with abrupt reset around 00:05, otherwise position/facing unchanged

findings.description: At ~00:04 the man's hand/razor is at the cheek/jaw completing a downward stroke; at ~00:05 the hand/razor instantly teleports back to the starting chin/philtrum position and restarts the identical chin->forehead->cheek sequence seen at 00:00-00:04. The motion does not continue plausibly across the loop point - action is restarted/skipped without intervening on-screen movement or plausible off-screen time, indicating a hidden loop cut.
